item.title: WEC owners purchase Ocala horse farm for $7.5 million
item.description: The owners of the World Equestrian Center and Golden Ocala Golf & Equestrian Club just purchased a 77-acre horse farm near their other properties in northwest Ocala for $7.5 million. Read more: WEC owners purchase Ocala horse farm for $7.5 million

item.title: Mother had severe ulcer before wrongful death at HCA Florida Ocala Hospital, son claims
item.description: An Ocala man is suing a local hospital, alleging that negligence and neglect during his mother’s hospital stay led to the development of a severe pressure ulcer that ultimately contributed to her wrongful death. Read more: Mother had severe ulcer before wrongful death at HCA Florida Ocala Hospital, son claims

item.title: Man gets life sentence in fatal shooting of teen boyfriend at Marion gas station
item.description: A 24-year-old man accused of fatally shooting his 17-year-old boyfriend at a Marion County gas station will spend the rest of his life in prison. Read more: Man gets life sentence in fatal shooting of teen boyfriend at Marion gas station

item.title: I don’t understand why disabled seniors should pay high property taxes for schools
item.description: "Fifteen years ago, we bought a property in Silver Springs Shores and we are very happy to live here, but what I don't understand is why those of us over 62 and disabled have to continue paying such high property taxes for schools. We no longer have children attending school, and these taxes keep increasing more and more, and they also add assessments for the area where we live, without prior notice, without considering that we are forced into retirement.
